explanation: The observed Job-2 priorities have upstream_rank 0 for every record, so the downstream ranking cannot preserve upstream provenance order. The supplied Job-2 input already contains evidence_sources whose record_id values are source ids like s01 through s08, while the needs/coverage record_id values are n06-r01 through n06-r08. The upstream assemble_provenance function is the supported localization because its source explicitly writes record_id from record.get('source_id', ''), causing the provenance handoff to lose the demand record identity before Job-2 consumes it.
